question: Paavo Nurmi games 2022 were hosted by______
solution:
The correct answer is __**Finland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Paavo Nurmi Games is an annual track and field competition held in Turku, Finland.
 
• It is named after Paavo Nurmi, a legendary Finnish long-distance runner and Olympic medalist.
 
• The event is part of the World Athletics Continental Tour Gold series, attracting top-tier athletes globally.
 
• The 2022 edition of the Paavo Nurmi Games took place on June 14, 2022, in Turku, Finland.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Paavo Nurmi**

 
 
• Paavo Nurmi, known as the "Flying Finn," is one of the most celebrated athletes in Olympic history.
 
• He won a total of 9 gold medals and 3 silver medals in middle and long-distance running events.
 
• His Olympic career spanned from 1920 to 1928, dominating events like the 1500 meters and 5000 meters.
 
 
 
• **World Athletics Continental Tour**
 
 
• The Continental Tour is a series of one-day track and field competitions organized by World Athletics.
 
• It is divided into Gold, Silver, and Bronze levels, with the Gold level being the highest tier of competitions.
 
• The tour aims to provide high-quality competition opportunities for athletes worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Turku**
 
 
• Turku is a city on the southwest coast of Finland, known for its historical significance and vibrant cultural scene.
 
• It is one of Finland's oldest cities and was the country's capital until 1812.
 
• Turku is also home to several sporting events, including the Paavo Nurmi Games.
 
 
 
• **Track and Field**
 
 
• Track and field is a sport that includes various running, jumping, and throwing events.
 
• It is one of the oldest forms of organized sports, dating back to ancient Greek and Roman times.
 
• Major competitions include the Olympic Games, World Championships, and Continental Tours.
